text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing patterns, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. Going further, deep learning uses complex layers of neural networks to handle very difficult problems, like recognizing faces in photos. You already use AI every day. It powers the recommendations on streaming services, voice assistants on your phone, and even the spam filters in your email. AI is not science fiction; it is a practical tool quietly shaping our modern lives.
